title: Mankind Is Allah's Deputy on Earth
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Dastoor, Ya Sayyidi Madad, Faatiha. Allah... Dastoor Ya Sayyidee, Ya Rijaalul-Lah.
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, La ilaaha illa-Llah. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar wa lillahi ‘l-hamd!
Anta Rabbuna anta hasbuna anta waliyuna ... w 'arhamna... wa aslih shaanana wa shaan al-muslimeen...
Ameen. Allahumma, Ya Allah ij`alna ma`a `ibadillahi saaliheen. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `ala Sayyidina
Muhammad (s).
Whole praying and glory that is granted by the Lord of Heavens, to the Seal of Prophets, most honored, most
glorified, most beloved one in His Divine Presence. Ya Rabba Sayyidina Muhammad (s) zidhu yaa Rabbee
`izzan wa sharafan wa nooran, wa surooran wa ridwaanan wa sultana! We are happy that our Creator is
giving us this chance for glorifying His Divine Being and also giving us this chance for praising and honoring
His most honored and glorified servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! O our Lord, forgive us and bless us!
(Mawlana sits.)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah

Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah
O our master who is leading this planet on its last station through this period of our physical being, the
master of this world who has the authority on our physical beings as well as on our spiritual beings. He knows
he has been granted a spiritual power to look at Mankind’s actions, thoughts and enjoyments. For Mankind’s
last target in this life, he is one person. You may look to him, you may see him as one of our people, yes. He
has an outward look like anyone from Mankind, but his inner being has been granted such a power from
heavenly levels that his spiritual being is gigantic! He has such a power to take this globe under his hand or
over his hands and to throw the planet through east or west!
O People, look and try to understand. He, the Almighty, is saying, “I am bringing a new creation and that
creation is going to be representative of My heavenly being. They should be My deputies. I am going to create
his physical being with My mighty hands. I am making, I am creating, I am designing.” Which design going to
be the most important through whole Creation? The level of being deputy of the Lord of Heavens, not any
other level. Lordship for Him, the Almighty, and servants should be honored to be His deputies on this
planet. If Almighty Allah (swt) not making Adam (a) to be His deputy, this planet never going to obey anyone,
not even angels, no.
This planet or globe coming under divinely hegemony and not any other countless creatures can carry that
power to be the Lord’s representatives. He just granted that to them; therefore, everything going to obey the
Almighty’s deputy. That is very important point to understand. Not any of the angels may command our
planet, because they are not deputies. The Lord of Heavens just making, creating. Do not say, “I am creating,”
rather (say), “I am doing.”
(Allah Almighty says,) “I am doing that new creation to be on behalf of Me, commanding on this globe.”
Everything on it or in it, under or over it, going to be under his command. That is a very powerful declaration
mentioned through the four holy books. What is the real being of Mankind? Therefore, if they are granting,
they can make a weak servant from Mankind to speak on it from now up to Day of Resurrection, neverending.
(Mawlana drinks hot tea for his throat.) O our listeners, when you are reaching to my age you should

understand what it is to be an old one. Old ones, our physical being getting weak and more weak and then
saying, “I finished.” Therefore sometimes, I am drinking such a thing, because cold coming and I need a little
bit hot tea for drinking. Don’t blame me. I hope that all of you may reach to my age and up also. Important
thing is that everyone is just created in such a way.

SubhaanAllah. As-salaamu `alaykum. O our listeners, how are you today? Too much collecting, too much
decisions? How much Mr. John? How much Sharif? Ahmad? How much? kam jam`atu ya ahlu lubnaan, kam
jam`atum ahlu 'l-fars. How many are you collecting today? O our listeners, collect, make heaps! One day, no
heaps, no tips. (laughter) We are not coming to dunya for collecting this world’s zibil, rubbish. Dunya is all
rubbish! Who is collecting so many things from dunya, he must know that he is collector of rubbish. Yes? O
our Lord, give us good understanding. We lost our good qualities for understanding. We are not asking where
are rubies, or emeralds or diamonds or pearls, but we are running after rubbish for this dunya.
Therefore, I am asking, what about today? Collecting? Send us a little bit; don’t put there, send to us. We
shall use it if you are not using! And you are saying, “We are not in need.” If you are not in need, why leaving
it there? You may one day be needy for that and you will say, “Why I am not giving for the sake of Allah, jalla
jalaaluhu jallat `azhamatuh?” Now, give! Don’t be collector. Be a generous one for giving. Don’t make like
this (closed hand). Give and Allah Almighty never leaving your hand empty. You give, Allah putting new.
Allah (swt) looking, “My servant giving, I am not leaving his hand empty. O My angels put in his hand more
and more.”
Why did this economical crisis happen? Because people were keeping their hands like this (closed;
stinginess) and not giving. Anything happened, their hands going like this (opens hand) and everything
falling down. The Lord is not giving to them. If they were giving, giving, giving, instead of making heaps of
golden jewels and dollars and Euros and pounds, the Lord of Heavens giving to them. It is because you are
making like this, not giving. Now economical crisis coming and people beginning to cry.
(Mawlana mimics sad voice), “I was something but I am now nothing. What shall I do? O my millions or
billions just disappeared. Yesterday, I was so proud with my billions and today I am asking from our
companies a little bit money for living. No money for me.”

The Lord of Heavens saying, “Give, O My servant. I am not leaving your hand empty!”
That is written through Old Testament, New Testament and Holy Qur’an and all heavenly books through
every prophet. It has been declared. Huuuu. But you are not believing and now coming that heavenly
punishment!
O people, now listen and enjoy. You may go tonight. Enjoy yourself. Shaytan saying to them, “O my followers,
don’t worry tonight. Go and drink till you are going to be drunk and you should forget everything, and you
should be happy.” Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. O our Lord, forgive us. O our Lord. Man is the deputy of the Lord of
Heavens on this planet! O my listeners, hear carefully, listen and try to understand what they said to me. That
deputy who has authority for the world to be under his command, he is going to act on this planet because he
is deputy of the Lord of Heavens. No globe can be without an owner. That owner, he is the Lord’s deputy. And
you may say, “O Shaykh, you are saying this but we are not looking and seeing.” Yes, if you are blind, how are
you going to see? Open your eyes to see. And then Grandshaykh, the master of this world, saying, “Say to
them, 'When you are going to be a complete deputy, that is when you will be granted to be a real deputy,
when you are passing from this temporary life to permanent life.'“
Yes, we are believers. It is written through the holy books that Allah Almighty going to collect all people on
the Day of Resurrection. He is Chief Judge for the Day of Resurrection. He has that holy attribute for
Himself, but granting the Day of Resurrection from that ocean, one point, and saying to him, "••••• •••
•••••••••• ••••••• •••••••• •••••••••••-`asaa an yab`athaka rabbuka maqaaman mahmooda, asta`idh billah Soon will thy Lord raise thee to a Station of Praise and Glory!"(17:59) “Come and be judge on your nation.” O
Arabs, O `ulama, O Wahabi people, you are understanding the meaning of `asaa an yaba`athuka rabbuka
maqaaman mahmooda. Khitaab, to whom was Allah Almighty addressing? To me, to you, to him? (Mawlana
stands.) Allah addressing to Sayyidina Muhammad (s), “O My beloved one, I am giving you the most honored
rank on the Day of Resurrection.” Despite Salafi and Wahabi beliefs, he (s) is doing as Allah Almighty
ordering him to be on Maqaam al-Mahmood. It is for only one, not two; can’t be two. That one is
Habeebullah. He was giving judgment on behalf of Allah!
Allah Almighty is so Great, can’t carry that the Day of Judgment for Himself; He Almighty is putting his
representative, “O My Habeeb, on behalf of Me, that Maqaam al-Mahmood, most honored station is for you.

Sit there and give your judgment.” Yes, giving. “Take this qalaam (pen) and give your judgment as you like.
You are not doing anything if I don’t like it.” “What you like,” means it is Allah's liking; He likes it. Then the
most glorified one going to sit on Judgment Throne and on the Day of Resurrection, giving some people their
certificates/permits to go to Paradise. They are entering. Some giving for them to go to hells. After that, so
many people getting in hells also. SubhaanAllahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Rahim. Allah Almighty, no one can be as
the Most Merciful! For the honor of the Seal of Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s), He will be taking out
people from hells until they are going to be empty!
O `ulama, why are you angry? You must be saying, “I was going to be member of hells!” It is not good for you
to be taken out? You think you are going to Paradise? Allah Almighty saying, “How dare you say, 'I am from
Paradise people'!” The last one Allah Almighty forgiving and ordering to be taken out and to be sent to
Paradise, the last one angels bringing to entrance of Paradise and heavenly khitab (pure, innocent)
addressing coming,
“O My servant, get in.”
“O my Lord, it is full.” He was approaching and going back ashamed.
“O My servant, get in My Paradise,” Allah Almighty ordering.
“O my Lord, it is full.” He was coming, looking and again backing away, ashamed.
What is your opinion, O `ulama? Is the Lord of Heavens, Allah Almighty laughing? Yes. Crying? No! Allah
never crying, but laughing. Third time, Allah Almighty laughing and saying, “O My servant, get in. I am
granting to you a paradise that is equal to ten surfaces of dunya. Go in.” You understanding? That is the
reason we are saying for every dunya, for every globe, there is going to be one deputy. Allah Almighty giving
that one, ten dunya-like paradises as he was created as His deputy to be in Paradise. wa min Allahi 't-tawfeeq.
Understanding? Never understanding. You must understand. It is important. Perhaps no one heard about it
from beginning up to today. Take care, O Mankind. Don’t be lazy, don’t be crazy, don’t be drunk, don’t be
idiot, don’t be heedless, don’t be kaafir (unbeliever), don’t be followers of Shaytan! Try to be your Lord’s
servant that He is granting to you. May Allah forgive us.
Dome dome dome dome 8x
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah

Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah
Faatihah. (44 minutes) Shukr, Ya Allah. SubhanAllah. (Mawlana makes sajda for shukr.)
(400,000 viewers on weekend and evening time!) Masha-Allah yaa Rabbee, shukran.
